diagnosis.cause: The pushed session guard and new replacement regression identify Unix sockets only by device/inode. The CI filesystem immediately reused that inode after unlink/rebind, so a replaced socket can compare equal and the new assertion fails. This mechanism is introduced by commit 2705217b in the adapter and test.

failure_record.log_evidence: Run 37399651291 job 112063742797: Nix HCC 0.1.1 checkPhase failed test_same_named_sockets_in_another_private_runtime_cannot_reuse_observation at test_hyprland_pointer_adapter.py:187; old and replacement socket records had identical device 66305 and inode 9889641 after immediate unlink/rebind. Magic Nix Cache rate limit was followed by cache.nixos.org fallback and did not terminate the gate.
